## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks run and their results. Explain checks not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch targets the current default branch and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, personal records, or client data are included.
- [ ] Deployment, migration, dependency, and rollback implications are documented where relevant.
